verdict.rationale: Grok Bot's own docs say connectors are installed as plugins from a Marketplace, which is the product's own directory-and-install mechanism. The FAQ's reference to services with a dedicated connector supports the existence of a connector catalog, but the evidence is a single thin mention with no detail on browsing or catalog breadth. Missing for 10: documentation of the Marketplace browsing experience, evidence of third-party (non-first-party) apps in the catalog, the install/auth flow, catalog size, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can browse a directory of third-party apps and connectors and add them to the assistant

citations.quote: Connectors are installed as plugins from Marketplace.
Grok Bot can use many browser-based tools, including services without a dedicated connector.
